page.overview:
What is Drahim Castle?

Drahim Castle is a ruined estate located south of Novigrad. As its description says, it was a stronghold of powerful Redanian House of Moskovitz. After the tragic death of its last member, Prince Adrien, only ruins remain of castle.

Prince Adrien's journal and a diagram for the Feline steel sword can be found here.
